name: elastic-cluster-triage-agent
description: 19 ES|QL triage tools for diagnosing Elasticsearch cluster issues from Stack Monitoring data.
long_description: An MCP server that connects directly to Elasticsearch and exposes 19 ES|QL-based diagnostic tools covering cluster health, node pressure, JVM GC, disk/shard pressure, thread-pool rejections, index pressure, ILM lifecycle stalls, indexing/search hotspots, error logs, and security audit events. Designed for use with the elastic-cluster-triage-agent skill in Claude Code and Claude Desktop.

tools.name: cluster_health_summary
tools.description: Show cluster health status, shard pressure, and node counts from the legacy monitoring stream.

tools.name: red_yellow_periods
tools.description: Track cluster-health periods where the monitoring stream reports yellow or red.

tools.name: node_last_seen
tools.description: Show the most recent monitoring sample for each node.

tools.name: node_pressure_summary
tools.description: Identify nodes with heap, CPU, disk, rejections, merge, or ingest pressure.

tools.name: jvm_gc_pressure
tools.description: Detect nodes with heap pressure and elevated GC activity.

tools.name: disk_shard_pressure
tools.description: Detect clusters with low disk space, growing shard counts, or unhealthy cluster status.

tools.name: thread_pool_rejections
tools.description: Detect write, search, or bulk rejection pressure by node.

tools.name: indexing_failure_analysis
tools.description: Spot write and ingest failure proxies that can block indexing progress.

tools.name: index_pressure_analysis
tools.description: Identify indices causing cluster pressure through load, latency, shard growth, cache pressure, or storage growth.

tools.name: unassigned_shard_analysis
tools.description: Find shard states that are not STARTED and may indicate allocation issues.

tools.name: hot_shards_analysis
tools.description: Identify indices with disproportionately large shard footprints or shard imbalance signals.

tools.name: slow_index_queries
tools.description: Find indices with the highest average query latency or sustained search load.

tools.name: index_growth_analysis
tools.description: Detect indices that are growing rapidly in the legacy monitoring stream.

tools.name: mapping_explosion_detection
tools.description: Find indices with fielddata, cache, or segment-growth pressure that can indicate mapping explosion.

tools.name: ilm_stuck_indices
tools.description: Find indices that look stalled in growth or throttled when ILM metadata is unavailable.

tools.name: indexing_hotspots
tools.description: Find heavy indexing volume, latency, or storage pressure by index.

tools.name: search_hotspots
tools.description: Find high search volume or slow searches by index.

tools.name: error_log_summary
tools.description: Summarize WARN and ERROR logs by node and message.

tools.name: audit_security_events
tools.description: Summarize authentication and authorization failures from audit or security logs.

kibana_url.title: Kibana URL (optional — enables Stack Monitoring deeplinks)
kibana_url.description: Kibana URL (e.g. https://your-cluster.kb.cloud.example.com). Enables clickable Stack Monitoring links in triage responses.

kibana_api_key.title: Kibana API Key (optional)
kibana_api_key.description: API key for Kibana. Leave blank to reuse the Elasticsearch API key — in most Elastic Cloud deployments the same key works for both.
